summary: Add report-stalls=#false to disable only a run's stall reports while keeping failure and cancellation reports

replay.detail: Existing definitions and run-report claims without report_stalls decode as true. True is omitted from serialized mission definitions and claims, preserving their existing revision identities. No projection migration is needed.

schema.detail: The mission model and mission-run.created / mission-run.report-to claim vocabulary gain optional Boolean report_stalls. No tables, indexes or triggers change.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules are unchanged. The claim registry digest changes with the optional field.

compatibility.detail: Mission DSL adds report-stalls=#true|#false (default true), requiring report-to. The local report-to API accepts optional report_stalls and st missions report-to accepts --report-stalls true|false; omission inherits the pinned mission policy. Existing stui/iOS client contracts are unchanged. Older daemons do not implement the false policy; upgrade fleet members before using it.

downtime.detail: No replay or migration on restart. Disabled stalls remove the run's stall reporting deadline; no scanning or polling is introduced.

manual.detail: Opt-out only. docs/st3/mission-graph-runtime.md documents the field and running-run command.

recovery.detail: Re-enable a running run with st missions report-to RUN --agent AGENT --report-stalls true --as ACTOR. Returning to an older binary enables stalls again for false policies; failure/cancellation reports keep working.
